title: Enter old records
intro: Add plucking rounds and sales from before you used the app, for example from WhatsApp. Only link a count to a tree when you're sure which tree it was.

round.treesHelp: Leave a tree empty if it wasn't plucked or you don't know its count.
round.unattributed: Nuts you can't tie to a tree (optional)
round.unattributedHelp: Counted in the round total, never in any tree's history or prediction.
round.exclude: Don't use this round for predictions
round.excludeHelp: Use this when the date or counts may be wrong.
round.addToStock: Add these nuts to current stock
round.addToStockHelp: Usually off: old nuts were sold or used long ago.
round.saved: Saved the round of {{date}}. Add another?
round.empty: Enter at least one tree count or a round total.
round.future: The date must be today or earlier.

sale.intro: Past sales are kept for your records and reports. They don't change today's stock.
